title: Tech Note: Migrating from 4D for Oracle to 4D for OCIusing OCI Mapper
author: Jamras Komoncharoensiri
featured_technology: OD Execute SQL / OD BIND TOWARDS SQL / OD BIND TOWARDS 4D
OD Create cursor / OD Set SQL in cursor

historical_commentary.text: Both the original 4D for Oracle plug-in and this OCI Mapper migration framework are long-discontinued artifacts of 4D's early direct-database-plug-in era, and the specific OCI-level commands described here have no bearing on how 4D talks to Oracle today. Modern 4D-to-Oracle connectivity would use ODBC or 4D's native SQL/data-source connectivity rather than either of these legacy plug-ins, making this note of historical interest only for understanding how 4D's Oracle integration evolved in the early 2000s.
related_updates: The 4D for Oracle and 4D for OCI plug-ins, and the OCI Mapper component described here, are long discontinued legacy products
